purpose: Exact absolute-instant value for the first complete B04-A earliest-start Temporal Constraint boundary rule.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: MaterialStateRef of the boundary rule owning this exact absolute value.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one absolute value for each B04-A absolute boundary state.

columns.name: boundary_at
columns.meaning: Exact finite absolute instant of the earliest-start boundary.
columns.value_contract: Finite timestamptz. It is not a fabricated resolution of a date, floating-local or named-zone-local value.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_boundary_absolute_state
primary_key.reason: At most one exact absolute boundary value per rule MaterialState.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_boundary_absolute_state_boundary_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Absolute payload exists only for a Temporal Constraint boundary state explicitly typed as absolute.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_boundary_absolute_state_finite
check_constraints.reason: Reject infinite timestamps from canonical B04-A boundary truth.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_boundary_absolute_state
indexes.reason: Exact boundary-value lookup by rule MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_boundary_absolute_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Reject incomplete or multiply-shaped canonical B04-A rule payloads by transaction end.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Immutable exact value attached to one historical Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Currentness is determined by the owning rule MaterialState and scoped current/history controls, not by this value row.
state_history.chronology: boundary_at is rule content, not creation/currentness chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime read access is SELECT-only; revise still appends a new MaterialState with a new typed payload.

lifecycle.retention: Retained as historical rule truth after revise or retire.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement does not erase prior boundary truth.

obligations: absolute earliest-start boundary has one finite timestamptz value
absolute payload exists only with the matching typed boundary discriminator
rule revisions append rather than rewrite boundary values
